research_question: can the frozen reduced Human-ID and repetition-boundary authority produce multiple causally supported bounded successors within five matched repetitions

progressive.active_model: one fixed authorized model per repetition
progressive.next_update_gate: post-update POSITIVE support for current active model

repetitions.seed_selection_rule: continue the consecutive Stage-5 controller-search sequence immediately after the frozen RPL-A seeds 20260825-20260827, fixed before outcomes

decision.PP2_A: at least two active bounded corrections beyond theta_1 occur within five repetitions, every next correction follows post-update POSITIVE support, evolution is stable, deployable prediction consistently improves, and no meaningful closed-loop regression appears
decision.PP2_B: authority works and at least one correction is applied without closed-loop regression, but fewer than two further supported corrections occur because evidence is neutral or insufficient
decision.PP2_C: post-update evidence is negative, parameters materially oscillate or drift, an update causes meaningful closed-loop degradation, or evidence authority becomes inconsistent

fixed_authorities.interface: fixed nominal Plant-v1 and controller nominal interface
